title: Tadap ke maa ne yeh Kaha
body:
Tadap ke maa ne yeh Kaha
Mere Hussian Mere Hussian
Sada e Fatima ye thi
Falak se ayi maa teri
<<DIVIDER>>
Laraz rahe hai Ambiya meri jaan
Kisi ka seena chid gaya
Gale pa teer chal gaya
Gazb ka tha Wo mareka meri jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Haram ki budoo bash mein
Wo pani ki talash mein
Khata ke bazu sogaya meri jaan
Wo Qanjare laien chala
<<DIVIDER>>
Tadapta qakh par raha
Tujhe na pani milsaka meri jaan
Badan se sar huwa juda
Laraz uthe hai Mustafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Qarar mera chin gaya meri jaan
Kabhi na dekha yeh suna
Mila na-abhi kabar ki jaan
Tujhe kafan bhi Na mila mere jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Aayi Sham-e-gham liye
Lute Haram Huzoor ke
Chine Gouhar tho dil jala meri jaan
Sata -e- Ummate Nabi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaye jaan -e- Fatima Ali
Wo Naiza dil pa ek chala meri jaan
Na raas aaya karbala
Jo saat aaya qafila
<<DIVIDER>>
Bala ke dasth me luta meri jaan
Iqbal Abedi suno
Likho tho nouha bas likho
Rula raha hai akbara mere jaan
